summary: Hood River County Eagle Butte: a 1917 newspaper note reports a lookout house under construction; no completion or later record found. Not the 1935 Warm Springs tower.

events.note: Rangers were gathering material for a lookout house in August 1917; the note does not report completion

evidence.supports: Site is in Hood River County, Mt. Hood National Forest
evidence.quote: Hood River County - Mt. Hood National Forest - 1N-7E-26

evidence.supports: Dated August 2, 1917 (The Oregonian): rangers gathering material for a lookout house on Eagle Butte
evidence.quote: The rangers of the southwestern part of the county are busy this week taking in material for the construction of a lookout house on Eagle Butte.

evidence.supports: The Eagle Butte with the 1935 tower is in Wasco County
Warm Springs tower built 1935, 107 ft, continues in active service
evidence.quote: Built in 1935, the 107’ Aermotor tower with 7’x7’ metal cab at Eagle Butte continues in active service.

evidence.supports: Warm Springs tower is on the reservation and closed to public access
evidence.quote: Located on the Warm Springs Indian Reservation, it is closed to public access.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR 1935 record (US 488, OR 81) is the Wasco County tower near Warm Springs at about 44.84 N, 121.23 W. The brief's Hood River County site (about 45.54 N, 121.91 W) is a different lookout, so the 1935 date is not applied to it.

sources.title: Eagle Butte - Forest Lookouts (Hood River County entry)

notes_for_editor: Only one primary-type record: a 1917 Oregonian note reprinted on the Forest Lookouts page. Nothing found on completion, staffing, fate, or present condition, so status and access are left unset. The brief's coordinates are about 45.54 N, 121.91 W, far west of the Warm Springs tower (44.84 N, 121.23 W); the Forest Lookouts Eagle Butte pages for 1974 and the CCC-ID tower records (Warm Springs Indian Agency, 1939-40) concern the Wasco tower and were deliberately not used. The firelookout.org Oregon county list has no Hood River County Eagle Butte entry, so a registry check may help the editor.
